name: Footer
subtitle: Chrome bar with the tip jar
summary: The closing bar of every page: the lockup, one sentence about the product, the tip jar and three link columns, on `chrome`.
guide:
The closing bar of every page: the lockup, one sentence about the product, the tip jar and three link columns, on `chrome`.

- **Use it on** every page, at the bottom of the page flow and never fixed.
- **You provide:** the lockup, the sentence, and links grouped as Product, Build and Resources. Endorsed products end with the mark and "by Charisma".
- **Tip jar:** three amount chips (1, 5, 10 STX) under a `label` "Tip the solver". After a tip, swap the chips for a thank-you line; on failure, show a `danger` line.
- **Columns:** four on desktop, two on mobile. Column titles use `label` on `on-chrome`; links use `on-chrome-muted`.
- **Don't** leave placeholder links (charisma.rocks has several today).

name: Header
subtitle: Lockup, nav, theme toggle, wallet
summary: The top bar of every app: the lockup, the primary nav, the theme toggle and the wallet button, on `chrome`.
guide:
The top bar of every app: the lockup, the primary nav, the theme toggle and the wallet button, on `chrome`.

- **Use it on** every page of every app, with the same structure on all of them.
- **You provide:** the app name for the lockup, three to five nav links (mark the current one with `aria-current="page"`), and the wallet state.
- **Layout:** 64px tall, `space-6` side padding. The lockup and nav sit left; the theme toggle and the wallet button sit right, with the toggle first. Nav links are `on-chrome-muted`, and the active link is `chrome-accent`. "Advanced" opens a menu of icon rows on `surface-raised`.
- **Mobile:** the nav moves into a right-side drawer (vaul) under a 36px menu button; the lockup and wallet button stay.
- **Endorsed products** (Zesty, Meme Roulette…) put their own name in the lockup slot. See Logo and lockups.
- **Don't** add balances, search or banners to the bar.

Hand-written from `apps/simple-swap/src/components/layout/header.tsx`. The theme toggle is an intentional addition; no app has one today.

name: Button
subtitle: Primary, secondary, quiet, loading, disabled
summary: The one button family: primary, secondary and quiet, at 40px or 56px.
guide:
The one button family: primary, secondary and quiet, at 40px or 56px.

- **Primary** (`accent` fill, `on-accent` label, `shadow-cta`) is for the single thing the view is for: Swap, Connect wallet, Create an order. Use at most one per view.
- **Secondary** (`surface` with a `line` border) is for every other action: View documentation, Execute order now.
- **Quiet** (no fill) is for cancel and dismiss actions, next to a primary.
- **Large** (56px, `cx-btn-lg`) is for the CTA that ends a card or a step, usually full width (`cx-btn-block`). This merges the swap CTA and Zesty's BigButton.
- **States:**
  - Hover lifts to `accent-hover` or `surface-hover`; a press scales to 0.98.
  - Loading keeps the label, adds a 16px spinner and says what's happening ("Confirm in wallet…").
  - Disabled is at 50% opacity, and stays focusable when you need to explain why.
- **Copy:** use a verb, in sentence case, with no trailing punctuation.
- **Don't** use gradients (the swap CTA's `from-primary to-primary/90` is retired), purple subnet buttons, or white labels on orange.

Hand-written from `apps/simple-swap/src/components/swap-interface/swap-button.tsx` and `apps/simple-swap/src/components/zesty/ui.tsx` (BigButton).

name: Chip
subtitle: Amount presets, range toggles, proof pill
summary: Small toggles and presets: amount presets, range toggles, tip amounts, the proof pill and share chips.
guide:
Small toggles and presets: amount presets, range toggles, tip amounts, the proof pill and share chips.

- **Use it for** one-tap choices beside an input or a chart: 25%, 50% and MAX on the swap pane; 7 days and 30 days on a chart; 1, 5 and 10 STX in the tip jar.
- **The selected chip** sets `aria-pressed="true"` and turns `accent-soft` with `accent-text`. Square chips (`radius-sm`) sit beside inputs; round chips (`cx-chip-round`) sit under charts and in share rows.
- **The proof pill** (`cx-proof`) links a live figure to Analytics: a `success` dot and one line, for example "$6.8M across Charisma pools".
- **Don't** use chips as tabs for whole pages; use the nav.

Hand-written from `apps/simple-swap/src/components/swap-interface/TokenInputSection.tsx`, `apps/simple-swap/src/components/zesty/ui.tsx` (Chip) and `apps/simple-swap/src/app/page.tsx` (Proof).
html: $6.8M across Charisma pools

name: ModeToggle
subtitle: Instant vs Triggered (Blaze)
summary: The segmented switch between Instant swaps and Triggered (Blaze) orders.
guide:
The segmented switch between Instant swaps and Triggered (Blaze) orders.

- **Use it** above the swap card, and anywhere one flow has two modes.
- **Dots:** Instant is `accent`, Triggered is `blaze`. The selected item fills with `surface-selected`.
- **Disabled:** when the token has no subnet, Triggered is disabled and its tooltip says why ("This token has no subnet yet").
- **Use it for** two or three options only. Don't hide a mode that changes what gets signed: show both, side by side.

Hand-written from `apps/simple-swap/src/components/swap-interface/swap-header.tsx`.

name: WalletButton
subtitle: Connect, connecting, connected
summary: The wallet entry point: Connect wallet, then Connecting…, then the short address.
guide:
The wallet entry point: Connect wallet, then Connecting…, then the short address.

- **Disconnected:** a primary button labelled "Connect wallet", in sentence case (today's "Connect Wallet" changes).
- **Connecting:** the same button with a spinner and "Connecting…".
- **Connected:** a secondary button showing the address in mono (`SP2ZN…55KS`) with a `success` dot. On `chrome`, it's an outline on `on-chrome-muted`. Clicking it opens the account menu.
- **Width:** at least 140px, so the header doesn't jump between states.

Hand-written from `apps/simple-swap/src/components/wallet-button.tsx`.

name: RouteDetails
subtitle: Path, impact, guarantees, loading
summary: The quote breakdown under a swap: the route path, price impact, guarantees and fees.
guide:
The quote breakdown under a swap: the route path, price impact, guarantees and fees.

- **You provide:** the path tokens, the hop count, price impact, the minimum received, price protection and the network fee.
- **Path:** 20px logos joined by chevrons, with "N hops" on the right.
- **Price impact:** a pill that is `success` under 1%, `warning` up to 5% and `danger` above. A high impact also adds a `danger` note above the CTA.
- **Minimum guaranteed** is in `success`. Figures are in mono.
- **Loading:** a spinner and "Analyzing optimal route...".
- Price protection is fixed at 1.0% today; there is no editable slippage control.

Hand-written from `apps/simple-swap/src/components/swap-interface/swap-details.tsx` and `swap-information-sidebar.tsx`.

name: SwapCard
subtitle: Send pane, reverse, receive pane, CTA
summary: The exchange itself: a send pane, the reverse button, a receive pane and one CTA, inside a card.
guide:
The exchange itself: a send pane, the reverse button, a receive pane and one CTA, inside a card.

- **Use it on** the swap page, and wherever a flow trades one token for another (DCA, Range, In & Out).
- **You provide:**
  - Both tokens.
  - The amount, with its USD hint.
  - The balance.
  - The quote: output, hops and subnet state.
  - The CTA label.
- **Panes** use `surface-sunken` inside the card's `surface`. The amount input is `num-xl` in mono, with a placeholder in `ink-faint`. The token trigger is a pill; the 25%, 50% and MAX chips sit under the amount.
- **Reverse:** a 40px round button on `surface-raised`, overlapping both panes.
- **Blaze:** when the output stays on the subnet, the receive pane shows a `blaze` "Subnet" pill and the token logo gets the flame.
- **CTA:** large and full width; primary only when the swap can run. Otherwise it says what's missing ("Enter an amount", "Insufficient STX").
- **Don't** add a second accent button, or decorative gradients behind the panes.

Hand-written from `apps/simple-swap/src/components/swap-interface/swap-interface-content.tsx`, `TokenInputSection.tsx`, `TokenOutputSection.tsx`, `reverse-tokens-button.tsx` and `swap-button.tsx`.

subtitle: Sizes, Blaze flame, fallback, pair

guide:
A token's round logo at 20, 32 or 48px, with its fallback, the Blaze flame and pair stacking.

- **You provide:** the image URL and the symbol.
- **Fallback:** the first two letters of the symbol, on `surface-hover` in `ink-body`. This replaces today's `bg-gray-200`.
- **Blaze:** subnet tokens get the filled flame on a `blaze` disc at the bottom right, ringed in `bg`.
- **Pairs:** overlap by 10px, with a 2px `bg` ring.
- **Never** crop a logo to a square, or recolour it.

A network badge (Stacks, Blaze, Ethereum, Bitcoin) is planned for bridging; it will take the flame's position. Hand-written from `apps/simple-swap/src/components/TokenLogo.tsx`.

summary: The token selection sheet: a title, a search field, and balance-sorted rows.
guide:
The token selection sheet: a title, a search field, and balance-sorted rows.

- **Use it** everywhere a token is chosen (14 places in simple-swap). It's full screen on mobile, and a centered `surface-raised` sheet over `overlay` on desktop.
- **You provide:** the token list with name, symbol, logo, balance, USD value and subnet flag; and the selected token.
- **Search** is 48px with a `radius-lg` field, the placeholder "Search by name, symbol, or address...", and a ⌘K hint.
- **Rows:** the logo, symbol and name on the left; the balance in mono and the USD value on the right. The selected row (`aria-selected`) uses `surface-selected` with an `accent-line` border; this replaces the blue→purple glow. Subnet tokens get the flame and a `blaze` pill.
- **Empty:** "No tokens found", with a hint to paste a contract address.

name: StatusPill
subtitle: Order, bot and Blaze states
summary: One- or two-word state labels, uppercase mono, with a dot.
guide:
One- or two-word state labels, uppercase mono, with a dot.

| State | Tone |
|---|---|
| Open, Live | accent |
| Confirmed, Filled | success |
| Broadcasted | neutral |
| Cancelled, Failed | danger |
| Paused | warning |

- **Don't** invent per-app colours (lottery blue, roulette green).

name: Dialog
subtitle: Balance check, over the scrim
summary: A modal decision on `surface-raised`, over `overlay`.
guide:
A modal decision on `surface-raised`, over `overlay`.

- **Use it for** decisions that block the flow: balance checks, purchases, bids, DCA setup.
- **You provide:** a title that states the situation, one or two sentences of body text, and one to three actions.
- **Actions:** the primary on the right, a quiet Cancel on its left.
- **Style:** `radius-lg`, `space-6` padding, `shadow-overlay`. On mobile, a bottom sheet (vaul).
- **Don't** use a dialog for information a toast or inline note could carry.

subtitle: Empty and loading
summary: What a list shows before it has items, and how it looks while loading.
guide:
What a list shows before it has items, and how it looks while loading.

- **Empty:** a 56px icon tile, a one-line title ("No orders yet"), one sentence on what will appear and why, and one primary action to make the first item.
- **Loading:** pulse skeletons in `surface-hover`, shaped like the real content.
- **Never** show an empty table header with no rows.

name: Toast
subtitle: Success with link, error, loading
summary: Short-lived confirmations and errors, bottom right, via sonner.
guide:
Short-lived confirmations and errors, bottom right, via sonner.

- **Success:** what happened, in past tense ("Swap transaction submitted"), the amounts, and a link to "View on Hiro Explorer" or "View orders".
- **Error:** what failed, whether funds moved, and what to do next.
- **Loading:** the step in progress ("Creating order…") and what the user must do.
- **Style:** `surface-raised` with `shadow-overlay`, and a 28px tinted icon disc (`success-soft` or `danger-soft`).
- **Don't** stack more than three; never toast something the page already shows.

subtitle: Zesty side picker
summary: A big, single-choice card: Zesty's up or down side picker.
guide:
A big, single-choice card: Zesty's up or down side picker.

- **You provide:** an icon, a short title, and one sentence on what Charisma will do for you.
- **Title:** uppercase, Zesty's voice. The icon disc is `accent` for the main choice and `ink` for the alternative.
- **Selected:** `aria-pressed="true"` and a 2px `line-strong` border (black in light, as on Zesty).
- **Use it for** two to four options that decide the whole flow; for anything smaller, use chips.

name: Steps
subtitle: Zesty progress, Launchpad stepper
summary: Progress through a multi-step flow: Zesty's segmented bar, and Launchpad's numbered stepper.
guide:
Progress through a multi-step flow: Zesty's segmented bar, and Launchpad's numbered stepper.

- **Segmented bar:** one 4px segment per step, done segments in `accent`, with "Step 1 of 4" in `label` underneath. Use it on mobile and in wizards.
- **Numbered stepper:**
  - A 28px circle per step.
  - A done step fills with `accent` and a check.
  - The current step has an `accent` ring.
  - Upcoming steps sit on `line`.
  - Use it for deploy flows.
- Keep step names to one word.

name: Card
subtitle: Card and nested pane
summary: The base surfaces: a card, and a pane nested inside it.
guide:
The base surfaces: a card, and a pane nested inside it.

- **Card:** `surface`, `line` border, `radius-lg`, `space-5` padding, and in dark, `shadow-card` and an 8px backdrop blur. Use it for any self-contained group: a feature, a tile, a form.
- **Pane:** `surface-sunken` with a `line-soft` border, inside a card. Use it for grouped inputs (the swap panes).
- **Raised:** `surface-raised` with `shadow-overlay`, for anything floating above the page.
- **Don't** put cards inside cards; use a pane instead. Never add a coloured left border.
